Drag empty space to look around. Use the arrow keys to move, PageDown to descend and PageUp to rise. Hold Shift to move faster. Scroll to glide forward or backward. On touch screens, drag to look, pinch to travel, or slide with two fingers to move sideways or vertically.

Click or tap an object to preview it, then choose Approach or Explore. The Atlas takes you directly to any discovery. Escape returns you to space.

32 curated experiences span eight playable solar systems, with five additional frontier territories for number theory, logic, topology, computation and deeper analysis. Frontier regions are honest distant signals, not completed lessons. Galaxies frame broad families, stars introduce major ideas, planets develop substantial concepts, moons connect examples, and travelling asteroids carry compact mathematical curiosities. Catch an archive to explore a fresh parameter setting. The scenery is stylized; orbital motion is not a gravity simulation. Dr. Mira offers authored guidance, not an external AI tutor.
